name: open_drawer
code:
def primitive(obj, target, p):
    handle = obj['parts']['handle']
    front = obj['parts']['front']
    
    handle_center = handle['center']
    handle_tip = handle['tip']
    handle_normal = handle['normal']
    front_normal = front['normal']
    
    # Approach from along the handle normal (pointing out from drawer)
    approach_offset = p['approach_offset']
    approach_x = handle_center[0] + handle_normal[0] * approach_offset
    approach_y = handle_center[1] + handle_normal[1] * approach_offset
    approach_z = handle_center[2] + p['approach_height_offset']
    
    # Compute yaw to align hand's x-axis with handle normal
    grasp_yaw = atan2(handle_normal[1], handle_normal[0])
    
    # Move to approach position
    move(approach_x, approach_y, approach_z, yaw=grasp_yaw, speed=0.2)
    open_gripper()
    wait(0.3)
    
    # Move to grasp position (at handle center)
    grasp_x = handle_center[0]
    grasp_y = handle_center[1]
    grasp_z = handle_center[2]
    move(grasp_x, grasp_y, grasp_z, yaw=grasp_yaw, speed=0.1)
    wait(0.2)
    
    # Close gripper to grasp handle
    close_gripper(force=p['grasp_force'])
    wait(0.5)
    
    # Pull drawer open along the front normal direction
    pull_distance = p['pull_distance']
    
    # Execute pull in segments for closed-loop control
    num_segments = int(p['num_pull_segments'])
    segment_dist = pull_distance / num_segments
    
    for i in range(num_segments):
        # Check current position
        current = look()
        if current:
            # Update handle position from perception
            current_handle = current['parts']['handle']
            current_center = current_handle['center']
            current_normal = current['parts']['front']['normal']
        else:
            # Fall back to dead reckoning
            current_pos = tcp()
            current_center = [current_pos[0], current_pos[1], current_pos[2]]
            current_normal = front_normal
        
        # Next waypoint along normal
        next_x = current_center[0] + current_normal[0] * segment_dist
        next_y = current_center[1] + current_normal[1] * segment_dist
        next_z = current_center[2] + p['pull_height_offset']
        
        move(next_x, next_y, next_z, yaw=grasp_yaw, speed=p['pull_speed'])
        wait(0.1)
    
    # Release handle
    open_gripper()
    wait(0.3)
    
    # Retract
    final_pos = tcp()
    move(final_pos[0] + front_normal[0] * 0.05, final_pos[1] + front_normal[1] * 0.05, final_pos[2] + 0.05, yaw=grasp_yaw, speed=0.2)
    
    return True
description: Approach the handle from the front normal direction, grasp it with fingers on either side (hand x-axis aligned with normal), then pull straight out along the drawer's front normal in segments with closed-loop perception updates to track the moving handle.
check: look() returns a drawer with parts.front.center moved outward along parts.front.normal by at least 0.08m compared to initial position

approach_offset.meaning: distance to approach from along handle normal before grasping

approach_height_offset.meaning: vertical offset from handle center during approach

pull_distance.meaning: total distance to pull drawer open

num_pull_segments.meaning: number of segments to divide pull motion for closed-loop control

pull_speed.meaning: speed in m/s when pulling drawer

pull_height_offset.meaning: vertical offset during pull to maintain grasp

lineage.description: pull a drawer open: grasp its handle and slide the drawer out along the front's outward normal
